This activity represents routine monetization of positions by private-equity vehicles, with the impact on DELL's share price depending on market absorption.

This notice is a procedural step enabling sales under Rule 144's safe-harbor framework.

news_headlines.title: Western Union telegraphs move from VMware to Nutanix

Brandon Shaw, VP and head of technology services at Western Union, stated that while the decision was not taken lightly, it was necessary to address an aging virtualization platform and align with the company's long-term strategy. This move reflects a broader trend of dissatisfaction among former VMware customers following Broadcom's acquisition and subsequent changes.
